name: powerjp
description: powerjp is a static web map and reproducible pipeline for exploring Japan's power-grid topology, facilities, and observed transmission-line power flow from public data.
capabilities: Explore transmission-line and substation geometry on a map
Inspect generation sites and unit output layers
View observed trunk-line power flow at 30-minute intervals
Compare layers and inspect source attribution in the interface

data_coverage.spatial_extent: Japanese power-system network and generation facilities represented by the published source data
data_coverage.area_supply_demand_temporal_resolution: hourly upstream data used for derived estimates

methodology: Ingest public source data into a reproducible local pipeline
Publish static, versioned artifacts with a manifest
Render the artifacts in a React, Vite, and Mapbox GL JS web map
limitations: This project visualizes observed flow; it is not an operational control system.
Not every published flow record has a recoverable physical line geometry.
Area-level demand is not building-level demand.
Published artifacts carry source-specific attribution and licensing conditions.

distribution.data: Cloudflare R2 or an R2-compatible CDN

license.published_artifacts: See the in-application attribution and source terms; ODbL applies to artifacts derived from All-Japan-Grid/OpenStreetMap.
